II-V-I.answer: Start with Autumn Leaves, Blue Bossa, and Tune Up. They give you repeated ii-V-I movement in clear sections, and the rest of the retrieved standards help you hear the cadence in different formal contexts like bridges, turnarounds, and A sections.

I-VI-II-V.answer: Start with Heart and Soul and Blue Moon, then compare them with I Got Rhythm and Honeysuckle Rose. That will help you hear the same cycle in both simpler and faster-moving standards.
